As a general note, for better visibility, you can try asking sandbox coding questions in the Questions Desk forum: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/c-891087/help:questions-desk

Remember to link the sandbox you're working in so we can double-check your code!

item.title: Re: 3-D login item
item.content:encoded:
Have you tried saving the page, instead of previewing?

Note: CSS Modules are only applied to a page after the page is refreshed. Previewing a page does not refresh the page. To see the effect of any modifications to a CSS Module, you must save the page.

item.content:encoded:
I added a new Category of Blackbox formats to the page. The code that creates both of these is already present in the base theme of the Site, Sigma-9, and has been there for many years, meaning that no CSS module needs to be used on the page to create them. However, you may want to adjust them, and I have included a portion that describes how to do that.

I didn't have any example pages for this, but two pages that could have used it are SCP-3989 and SCP-2783.

Anyway, point being: Thanks for the awesome CSS work!
